comment: Static IL patches applied to the player's sts2.dll by Spire.Patcher (tools/build_logic.py). Each replaces a Harmony patch from sts2-cli; handlers for 'redirect' ids are in logic/Spire.Logic/Hooks.cs. A missing non-optional target fails the build: that is the signal the game API moved (see docs/LOGIC_BUILD.md).

patches.note: UI animation delays. Without a scene tree they never complete (sts2-cli: PatchCmdWait).
Speech-bubble VFX NREs without the UI and breaks enemy moves (sts2-cli issue #64). Return value is ignored by callers.
sts2-cli setup.sh patch 2. Try disabling once the adapter runs: on one thread the real wait may now work and would be more faithful.
Returns the table text, or the key when missing (the original throws).
Scroll Boxes bundle choice becomes a bundle_select decision.
sts2-cli replaces Neutralize's effect because DamageCmd.Attack().Execute() NREd headless. That changes game behaviour, so it is off; enable only if the NRE reproduces, and then find its real cause.
